blocks.orig: 9 DAYS TANZANIA DIAMOND-LUXURY SAFARI WITH ALL MAJOR PARKS!
blocks.html: 9-day Diamond luxury safari in Tanzania covering all the major parks!

blocks.orig: You’ve always wanted to go on a safari, but camping is not your cup of tea? No worries, this safari experience will be exactly what you’ve been dreaming of. Exploring during the day and relaxing in our Diamond class hotels in the evenings.
blocks.html: A safari has long been on your wish list, but sleeping in a tent doesn’t appeal to you? Not a problem: this safari is just what you have been hoping for. You spend the days exploring and the evenings unwinding in our Diamond class hotels.

blocks.orig: During this 9-day-safari you dive deeper into all the major parks like the world-famous Serengeti with its wildebeest migration, the stunning Ngorongoro Crater with the world’s highest wildlife concentration and the Tarangire National Park, the home of the elephants.
blocks.html: Over these 9 safari days you get to know all the major parks in depth: the Serengeti, known around the world for its wildebeest migration, the beautiful Ngorongoro Crater, which has the highest density of wildlife on earth, and Tarangire National Park, where the elephants live.

blocks.orig: In our luxurious and authentic lodges you can relax, enjoy local cuisine from fabulous chefs and catch a good night’s sleep before you awake your inner explorer the next day once more.
blocks.html: Our lodges are luxurious and authentic: you can unwind, taste local dishes prepared by excellent chefs and sleep well before your inner explorer wakes up again the following day.

blocks.orig: Many travelers ask us when the best time is to visit Tanzania. The answer is … there is not one right answer. It depends on what you want to see, where you want to go, your budget and interests. Please find a comprehensive guide on when is the best time to visit Tanzania here.
blocks.html: A question we hear from many travellers is when to go to Tanzania. The honest reply … no single answer fits everyone. It comes down to what you hope to see, the places you want to visit, your budget and your interests. You can read our detailed guide on the best time to visit Tanzania here.

blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: On a safari with us in Tanzania you get the chance to discover the country’s remarkable wildlife and beautiful scenery. Private safaris are our focus, so the 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep is for you alone. You decide when each safari day begins and finishes, and on the day itself our experienced guides are happy to help you choose. Perhaps you would like to see the animals at their liveliest around sunrise and sunset, when it is pleasantly cool, or perhaps you would rather finish the afternoon at the pool; the choice is completely yours. Because the wildlife of Tanzania is active at different moments of the day, you’ll get many chances to watch the animals in action.

Planning your Tanzania trip with us means more than a booking; it’s the start of an experience shaped around you. First we listen to your wishes and preferences, and we keep going until each part of the journey matches what you have in mind. blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, definitely: Tanzania is known as one of the best places to see the Big Five. You can watch these impressive animals (lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo) in their natural surroundings, which is why so many wildlife lovers choose Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is a safe and friendly country to travel in. You’ll find a welcoming atmosphere, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, so you can enjoy the scenery and wildlife with peace of mind. People are kind, and simple precautions like keeping an eye on your belongings remain sensible, as they would be anywhere in the world. With its natural beauty and warm-hearted people, Tanzania is a wonderful country to visit.

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide welcomes you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' Your guide drives you directly to your hotel, so you can unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. On the following day your guide sets off with you on an exclusive, private safari where you decide the pace. You have the luxury of a safari jeep of your own, and you are free to stop and look at the animals for as long as you want!

blocks.orig: After a magical flight over Tanzania's savannahs, you arrive in the heart of Tarangire National Park. Your driver awaits you here for your first game drive of the day. Usually, your flight takes you to the park in time for lunch, which you can have in the middle of the savannah. A classic safari sundowner concludes the day, and the sight of the last sun shining over the herds of elephants and the ancient baobabs trees of the Tarangire plains is truly mesmerizing!
blocks.html: Following a magical flight across the savannahs of Tanzania, you land in the middle of Tarangire National Park. Here your driver is waiting for the first game drive of the day. Your flight normally gets you to the park in time for lunch, which you can eat out on the savannah. The day ends with a classic safari sundowner, and watching the last sunlight fall over the elephant herds and the age-old baobab trees of the Tarangire plains is truly mesmerising!

blocks.orig: In the majestic Tarangire National Park, the focus lies on grandeur - cross paths with the countless gigantic baobab trees, in search of vast herds of elephants. And these giants are not the only large game you find here, since the Tarangire River and Lake Burunge attract countless lions, zebras, giraffes, leopards, cheetahs, pythons, and monkeys to their waters. For smaller species, the grandeur lies in the numbers, as Tarangire is also an absolute haven for birdwatchers!
blocks.html: Grandeur is the theme in majestic Tarangire National Park: you pass countless huge baobab trees while you look for big herds of elephants. They are not the only large animals here either, because the waters of the Tarangire River and Lake Burunge draw countless lions, zebras, giraffes, leopards, cheetahs, pythons and monkeys. Among the smaller species the grandeur is in their numbers, since Tarangire is also a true haven for birdwatchers!

blocks.orig: Gibb's Farm offers the old-age rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation, right on the slopes of Ngorongoro Highlands. Walk around on this sanctuary of peace and tranquility, and watch vegetables being harvested, coffee roasted, cows milked, and pigs fed. The vegetable gardens, fruit trees, and herbs provide inspiration for the farm's chefs, who in their turn amaze visitors with a delicious lunch. A little piece of heaven!
blocks.html: On the slopes of the Ngorongoro Highlands, Gibb's Farm follows the age-old rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation. Stroll around this peaceful, tranquil sanctuary and see vegetables harvested, coffee roasted, cows milked and pigs fed. The farm's chefs find their inspiration in the vegetable gardens, fruit trees and herbs, and they in turn delight guests with a delicious lunch. A small piece of heaven!

blocks.orig: Today you descend into the wonderous caldera of the famous Ngorongoro Crater. This is THE day to start your game drive early when animals are plenty and tourists few! Feel the little hairs on your arms rise as you descend into the crater, awed by the sight of clouds hovering and the numerous animals in sight. Coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles, and many more animals can be found here and you are almost guaranteed to see them all.
blocks.html: Today you drive down into the wondrous caldera of the well-known Ngorongoro Crater. On THIS day it pays to begin your game drive early, when there are plenty of animals and few tourists! As you go down into the crater you will feel the hairs on your arms stand up, amazed by the hovering clouds and the many animals around you. Coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles and plenty of other animals live here, and you are almost certain to see all of them.

blocks.orig: Fly into the mind-blowing beautiful Serengeti National Park for the epitome of safari. See the infamous Big Five in all their glory, and, in certain months, wildebeests running by the thousands in the Great Migration. And even without that; this is big-cat-paradise with prides of lions on kopjes, cheetahs in the long, yellow grass, and leopards in trees. You arrive in time for an amazing afternoon game drive into the sunset.
blocks.html: Take a flight into the breathtaking Serengeti National Park for safari at its very essence. Watch the well-known Big Five in all their glory and, in certain months, thousands of wildebeests running past during the Great Migration. Even without the migration, this is a paradise for big cats, with lion prides on kopjes, cheetahs in the tall yellow grass and leopards in the trees. You get there in time for a wonderful afternoon game drive into the sunset.

blocks.orig: Anything you can think of when you picture a luxurious safari, you will surely find in Serengeti National Park. Not only the Big Five, the famous Great Migration, and a multitude of big cats, but also rarer species such as the gerenuk or the wild dog, and did we mention the plus 500 species of birds? In between, you naturally spot antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos, and many more animals. Make sure to wake up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!
blocks.html: Whatever comes to mind when you imagine a luxurious safari, you are sure to find it in Serengeti National Park. There are the Big Five, the famous Great Migration and many big cats, but also rarer animals like the gerenuk or the wild dog, and have we mentioned the more than 500 bird species? Along the way you will of course see antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos and much more. Be sure to get up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!

blocks.orig: After an amazing safari adventure, you take a plane back to Arusha, after which you are transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your international flight home.
blocks.html: Once your safari adventure is over, you fly back to Arusha, and from there a transfer takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your international flight home.
